title: Chapter 1484
text:
A few days later, on a residential planet in the Ancient Star Desert.

"Hiss, this woman …"

Han Xiao walked on the bustling streets, passing through the bustling crowd. He turned on his stealth function and was not discovered by the passersby. From time to time, he would rub his waist and mutter softly.

It was not easy for him to appease Ames and leave behind an Information Anchor Point. In the end, he was able to leave the scene of the crime and go to another city planet. He planned to take a walk and find a new Information Anchor Point.

"I already have quite a number of Information Anchor Points on me. I can feel that my information foundation is much stronger, but I keep feeling that I'm still lacking something …"

Han Xiao looked around and muttered to himself.

After walking for a while, he suddenly stopped and looked ahead.

Not far ahead was a physical Wayne Card store. There was a sea of people at the entrance, and there was a long queue. Beside them was a poster of his extraordinary heroism. On the notice board was the business activity. Today was the release day of the Black Star Collector's Edition Card Set.

In front of the store, a shop assistant was shouting.

"There are a total of twenty-four Black Star Collector's Edition Card Set, including cards from different periods of Black Star. There are also thirteen new cards, all of which are equipped with holographic special effects. Appearance, attack, defense, activation of special effects, and other actions have different holographic images. The collection value is extremely high, and it is a new product that Wayne Card enthusiasts must not miss. There are only 8,000 sets in our store, and each person can only buy two sets at most. It is a limited release …"

The long line of people in front of the store rubbed their fists and wiped their palms. Their faces were filled with impatience, like a group of lively leeks waiting to be cut.

"Did you make a Solo Card Set for me?"

Han Xiao blinked, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.

Although the Wayne Cards included most of the famous big shots in the galaxy, there were only a few who had a single card series. From this, it could be seen how popular he was in the galactic society … Speaking of which, should he increase the usage fee for his portrait this year?

At this moment, Han Xiao's intuition suddenly throbbed. He sensed a new Information Anchor Point, and his expression changed slightly.

"Wait a minute, could the Wayne Card also be an information anchor point …?"

He quickly narrowed his eyes and sensed it before heaving a sigh of relief.

The next moment, he opened his virtual vision and instantly covered the entire planet.

The lives of the galactic residents jumped into his eyes.

Han Xiao saw it?

Some people put up posters of him at home, and some people bought figurines of him?

Someone is watching a movie based on me … Galactic residents related to me?

They were marked in his field of vision and lit up one after another.

"This information anchor point?

From the galactic society itself … "

Han Xiaoxin's expression flickered.

Did he bring countless changes to the galactic society and deviate from the trajectory of his previous life?

These are all traces of my past — the changes I made to this world?

All of them were information anchor points.

After experiencing all kinds of storms, the galactic society finally had a long-awaited peace. Behind the peaceful and happy lives of every galactic resident, there was their own shadow?

The respect and memories that everyone in the galactic society had for him?

It was the biggest information anchor point.

As the galactic residents lit up in his virtual vision one by one, Han Xiao felt that this information anchor point was being strengthened, and his information foundation was becoming more and more solid.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed as he understood.

Perhaps this was the most important information anchor point, witnessing the changes he had made to this world with his own eyes?

Look at the new lives he had brought to countless people … Walking through the mortal world, reading all living beings?

This would anchor him deeply in the entire world.

"Come to think of it, this kind of style?

Is it Xianxia or Cthulhu … "

Han Xiao mocked him in his mind. Then, he stopped smiling.

Stand still?

Virtual abilities were fully activated.

The next moment?

Countless Virtual Souls split out and scattered to the various planets along the quantum network, taking in the lives of countless people.

The people of the various planets were lit up, and the virtual vision seemed to see a bright galaxy. The information anchor point seemed to have absorbed endless nutrients and continued to grow in this process.

…

Central Galaxy, three Universal Civilizations' joint conference room.

The remote projections of Marbruce and the other two sat behind the table, whispering to each other from time to time, their eyes always fixed on the door.

"Strange, why isn't Black Star here yet?"

"I've already sent him a message, but he hasn't replied yet. I wonder if he received the message from today's meeting?"

"He must have received it, but he's probably too lazy to reply. Recently, he's also been busy preparing for the information transformation …"

"Speaking of which, what does he need to prepare? I saw the recent intelligence report that Black Star has been visiting various civilizations and releasing and receiving data on the quantum network. I wonder what effect this has on our plan? "

"I don't understand, but he's the user of the Information Materialization device. He definitely knows what he's doing …"

The three of them discussed softly.

During this period of time, they had also been preparing for the transformation and had completed a series of preparatory measures.

Although Han Xiao controlled the Information Materialization device, it was not something that could be directly activated. According to the rumors of the Sanctum, many auxiliary facilities were needed to transform the entire dark side universe. What the three Universal Civilizations did was to create a large number of supporting facilities for the Information Materialization device and install them in various divided areas. The blueprints were provided by Han Xiao, and they were all auxiliary equipment used to strengthen the change of the Information Form.

The three Universal Civilizations spent some manpower and resources to install these supporting facilities. The hardware aspect had been resolved, and now there was only the coordination problem left. They needed to finalize the official implementation time of the transformation before it could be implemented. Many of them were trivial matters, but the three Universal Civilizations handled them easily, so Han Xiao assigned them all these chores.

Just as the three of them were chatting, the door suddenly opened. The secretary led Han Xiao in before leaving and closing the door, leaving space for the big shots.

"Black Star, you're late. We thought you weren't coming today." Marbruce heaved a sigh of relief.

"I was preparing for the transformation and was delayed."

Han Xiao explained casually.

Just as the three of them were about to say something, their gazes suddenly became strange.

Although Han Xiao's appearance did not change, for some reason, they felt that the feeling Han Xiao gave them was completely different from the last time they met.

Now, Black Star's aura gave them an indescribable feeling. It was inexplicably deep, as if they were staring at a black hole.

"You seem a little different …" Marbruce's tone was hesitant, suspecting that it was his imagination.

"I've deepened my connection with the dark side universe. This is all normal."

Han Xiao waved his hand nonchalantly.

During this period of time, he had visited most of the civilizations in the galactic society and taken them all into his heart. He had perfected the last Information Anchor Point. At this point, his information foundation had become extremely thick, giving him the illusion that everything was one.

Han Xiao did not go into details. He paused for a moment before asking,

He paused for a moment and said, "I'm almost done with my preparations. What about you guys?"

He paused for a moment and said, "We're still inclined to spend some time investigating all the Sanctums … But in principle, we're all willing to cooperate with you to carry out the transformation plan. We just need to set a time."

"Alright, the transformation isn't done overnight. It might take a few years, or it might take decades or even centuries, so the sooner we start, the better."

"Hmm, we're here for a meeting to discuss the exact date."

Three.

The man nodded.

"… Alright, let's talk then."

After saying that, Han Xiao exhaled softly.

"I've finally reached this step …"
